quarterly_data.signal: 10-K legal proceedings: on June 25, 2026 certain individuals and businesses filed a putative class action in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California against Micron, Samsung Electronics (and one of its subsidiaries) and SK hynix (and one of its subsidiaries) on behalf of a putative class of DRAM purchasers, alleging the defendants conspired to restrict the supply of, and fix prices for, DRAM products in violation of the Sherman Act and state antitrust and consumer protection laws for a period beginning October 26, 2022; the complaint seeks damages, treble damages, injunctive relief, attorneys' fees and costs. On July 17, 2026 an individual filed a complaint with similar allegations against the same defendants in the U.S. District Court for the District of Hawaii.

10-K legal proceedings (pending patent suits by Yangtze Memory Technologies, YMTC): in the Northern District of California YMTC sued Micron and a subsidiary on November 9, 2023 (eight U.S. patents, certain 3D NAND products) and on July 12, 2024 (eleven U.S. patents, certain 3D NAND and DDR5 DRAM products); in China, Micron Semiconductor (Shanghai) and Micron were served with three complaints from the Beijing Intellectual Property Court (January 22 and February 27, 2024) and Micron Semiconductor (Shanghai) with five complaints from the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court (September 11, 2024), alleging infringement of Chinese patents by importing and selling certain 3D NAND products and SSDs in China. Each complaint seeks an injunction, damages, attorneys' fees and costs.
